name: Dongwu Cement International Limited
summary: Dongwu Cement International Limited, an investment holding company, engages in production and sale of cement under the Dongwu brand name in the People's Republic of China. It offers ordinary and composite Portland cement, as well as clinker as a by-product; sells motor machines and parts, rare earth materials, metals, and anode materials and oxides; and electroplating and processing, and calcination services. The company is also involved in the sewage treatment activities; science and technology investment business; investment management and consultation activities; and production and sale of magnetic materials and other application products.
